name: Burning Blessing: Supreme Symphony
description:
Roll Phase: Always roll 2 Pyro Dice and 2 Dendro Dice.
After you play a card whose Current Elemental Dice Cost is at least 2: This card gains 1 stack (up to 3 stacks).
Each stack on this card increases the DMG dealt by your Burning Flame by 1.
